description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing Markdown link rendering in a Confluence content format implementation within a documentation generator project.

classes.name: LinkRendererTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the correct rendering of Markdown links into HTML, including external links, internal anchor links, and Confluence-specific links, within the documentation project.

methods.name: providerRenderLink
methods.description: A data provider method returning test cases with expected HTML output, Markdown input strings, and current page contexts for the link rendering tests.

methods.name: testRenderLink
methods.description: A test method that sets up a virtual filesystem, configures the documentation environment, and asserts that Markdown input strings are correctly converted to expected HTML output.
